project.currentFocus: Begin the frontier-exploration baseline by validating the SLAM and mapping workflow in simulation
project.nextAction: Inspect slam.launch.py arguments, launch SLAM with simulation time, teleoperate the simulated robot, then save and validate the first map

result.summary: Stage 4 completed in simulation. Gazebo Sim 8 ran the depot and warehouse worlds; TurtleBot4 model spawn, simulation time, TF, LiDAR, odometry, RGB-D streams, controlled motion, multi-world parity and clean restart recovery were verified with ROS 2 output and RViz/Gazebo evidence. Physical-robot behavior remains a separate validation scope.
evidence: ROS 2 /cmd_vel, /odom, /scan, /tf and RGB-D output captured during Stage 4

history.title: Stage 4 simulation and scenario validation completed
history.detail: The depot and warehouse simulation baselines, LiDAR, RGB-D, odometry, TF, controlled motion and restart recovery were verified. Stage 5 is now active. This completion applies to simulation only; physical TurtleBot4 validation remains separate.
